overview_description.description: Profound is a platform designed to enhance brand visibility, specifically within AI-generated responses, helping businesses remain competitive in search engine landscapes where users get answers without clicking through. The platform collects and analyzes data on prompt volumes, citation frequency, agent interactions, and AI crawler behavior to show which queries surface a brand and how content is used in AI outputs. It also offers tools to generate content briefs, track AI interactions with websites, and provide insights that support content strategy decisions. Profound’s system aims to give marketing and content teams visibility into evolving AI discovery channels and align content with questions users ask these systems.

product.name: Answer Engine Insights
product.description: A platform module for tracking brand visibility in AI-generated answers, analyzing responses and citations, and identifying opportunities to improve performance across answer engines.

product.name: Agent Analytics
product.description: A website observability product that shows how AI crawlers and agents access, interpret, and reference a company’s content, including resulting AI-driven traffic.

product.name: Prompt Volumes
product.description: A market-intelligence tool that measures what people ask AI answer engines, helping brands identify relevant topics, search demand, audience patterns, and visibility opportunities.

product.name: Profound Workflows
product.description: A workflow platform for auditing, researching, creating, optimizing, and publishing content designed for visibility in AI-generated answers.

product.name: Shopping
product.description: A product-visibility module for analyzing and improving how products appear in ChatGPT Shopping, including shopping triggers, placement, retailers, and reviews.

product.name: Profound Index
product.description: A data product and leaderboard that ranks brands according to their visibility in answers generated by leading AI models.
